title: Rav Chanin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin 85b: “Rav Chanin — and some say Rav Chanin of Mechoza — said to Rav Ashi.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes “Rav Nachman said to him,” as in Kiddushin 6b, identifying him as the later Rav Nachman, as explained in his entry.
